title: Clash of Clans Intro
blurb: The Clash of Clans startup — the war-horn fanfare that opened a billion sessions of village-checking. It's mobile gaming's most nostalgic three seconds: hearing it teleports an entire generation back to raid planning and builder anxiety. Play it before any strategic undertaking, from actual games to dividing the restaurant bill.
origin: The startup fanfare from Clash of Clans (Supercell).
